entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Patna
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.P.P. for the State.

2. The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner seeks anticipatory bail in connection with Jahanabad Mahila P.S. Case No. 09 of 2024 registered for the offences punishable under Sections 341, 323, 498A, 504, 506, 494 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code.

entities.text: Jahanabad Mahila P.S. Case No. 09 of 2024
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
It is further submitted that the investigation in the case against the petitioner is still continuing, but then he has not been given the benefit of Section 41A of the Cr.P.C.
3.

The learned APP for the State submits that the offences for which the instant FIR has been instituted against Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.58094 of 2024(2) dt.09-08-2024 the petitioner carries punishment of less than seven years, the said submission of the learned APP is not disputed by the learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner.

5.

sentences.text:
The petitioner would be at liberty to file a representation before the concerned Superintendent of Police and the Investigating Officer of the case within a period of three weeks from today with a web copy of the order dated 13-2-2024 in Criminal Miscellaneous No. 3536 of 2024 (Naushad Ansari Vs.
